definitions.name: O3C.BCODE
definitions.note: One bracket character to its code: ( 1, ) -1, [ 2, ] -2.

definitions.name: O3C.BDELTA
definitions.note: One bracket character to +1 when it opens and -1 when it closes.

definitions.name: O3C.BSTEP
definitions.body: 'C' BIND 'S' BIND S -1 DROP S C 1 COLLECT CONCAT 2 COLLECT 0 1 C 0 LT S -1 GET C ADD 0 EQ AND SELECT GET
definitions.note: FOLD/SCAN step on a bracket-code stack (sentinel 0 at the bottom): a closer cancels a matching top opener, otherwise the code is pushed.

definitions.name: O3C.MED
definitions.body: SORT 'S' BIND S LENGTH 'N' BIND S N 1 SUB 2 DIV FLOOR GET S N 2 DIV FLOOR GET ADD 2 DIV
definitions.note: Median of a non-empty Vector of numbers (mean of the two middle values when even).

definitions.name: O3C.PAIRS
definitions.body: 'V' BIND V TRUE 1 COLLECT V -1 DROP CONCAT 2 COLLECT ZIP
definitions.note: Vector to [ element previous ] pairs; the first previous is TRUE, which equals no number.

definitions.name: O3C.PAIRS0
definitions.body: 'V' BIND V V 1 TAKE V -1 DROP CONCAT 2 COLLECT ZIP
definitions.note: Vector to [ element previous ] pairs; the first previous is the first element itself.

definitions.name: O3C.RID
definitions.body: O3C.PAIRS [ 'P' BIND 1 0 P 0 GET P 1 GET EQ NOT SELECT ] MAP 0 [ ADD ] SCAN
definitions.note: Vector to run ids: the running count of run starts, so equal adjacent values share one id.

solutions.brackets.depth: CHARS [ O3C.BDELTA ] MAP 0 [ ADD ] SCAN 'P' BIND P P 0 [ MIN ] SCAN SUB 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
solutions.brackets.balanced: CHARS [ O3C.BCODE ] MAP [ 0 ] [ O3C.BSTEP ] FOLD LENGTH 1 EQ
solutions.brackets.balanced_prefix: CHARS [ O3C.BCODE ] MAP [ 0 ] [ O3C.BSTEP ] SCAN [ LENGTH 1 EQ ] MAP 'T' BIND T 0 [ 'E' BIND 1 ADD ] SCAN 1 0 T SELECT MUL 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
solutions.brackets.unmatched: CHARS [ O3C.BCODE ] MAP [ 0 ] [ O3C.BSTEP ] FOLD LENGTH 1 SUB
solutions.ledger.debtors: O2A.BYKEY 'R' BIND R KEYS [ 'N' BIND R N GET 0 LT ] FILTER
solutions.ledger.largest_entry: 'E' BIND E [ 1 GET ] MAP G0A.ARGMAX 'I' BIND E I GET
solutions.messy.title: G0A.WORDS [ LOWER G0B.CAP ] MAP G0B.SPACED
solutions.messy.sorted_unique: G0A.WORDS [ LOWER ] MAP UNIQUE SORT G0B.SPACED
solutions.prose.longest: G0A.WORDS 'WS' BIND WS [ CHARS LENGTH ] MAP G0A.ARGMAX 'I' BIND WS I GET
solutions.prose.initials_of_long: G0A.WORDS [ CHARS LENGTH 3 GT ] FILTER [ CHARS 0 GET UPPER ] MAP JOIN
solutions.runs.rle: 'V' BIND V O3C.RID V GROUP VALUES [ 'R' BIND R 0 GET R LENGTH 2 COLLECT ] MAP
solutions.runs.upruns: O3C.PAIRS0 0 [ 'P' BIND 'A' BIND A 1 ADD 1 P 0 GET P 1 GET GT SELECT ] SCAN 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
solutions.runs.dedupe: O3C.PAIRS [ 'P' BIND P 0 GET P 1 GET EQ NOT ] FILTER [ 0 GET ] MAP
solutions.runs.majority: 'V' BIND V TALLY 'T' BIND T G0A.TOPKEY 'M' BIND M NIL T M GET 2 MUL V LENGTH GT SELECT
solutions.sensor.filled: 'V' BIND V V O1D.PRESENT 0 GET [ 'E' BIND 'A' BIND E A E NIL? NOT SELECT ] SCAN
solutions.sensor.gap_count: [ NIL? ] MAP 'MF' BIND 1 0 MF SELECT 'Z' BIND 0 1 COLLECT Z -1 DROP CONCAT 'PZ' BIND Z 1 PZ SUB MUL G0A.SUM
solutions.sensor.longest_gap: [ NIL? ] MAP 'MF' BIND MF 0 [ 'E' BIND 'A' BIND A 1 ADD 0 E SELECT ] SCAN 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
solutions.sensor.ratios: 'V' BIND V 1 DROP V -1 DROP DIV
solutions.sensor.scaled: 'V' BIND V V O1D.PRESENT G0D.MAXV DIV
solutions.series.mad: 'V' BIND V O3C.MED 'M' BIND V M SUB [ 'D' BIND D D -1 MUL MAX ] MAP O3C.MED
solutions.series.moving3: 'V' BIND V -2 DROP V 1 DROP -1 DROP ADD V 2 DROP ADD 3 DIV
solutions.series.runmax: 'V' BIND V V 0 GET [ MAX ] SCAN
solutions.series.mode: V TALLY 'R' BIND R VALUES G0D.MAXV 'M' BIND R KEYS [ 'K' BIND R K GET M EQ ] FILTER O2D.MINV
